procedure: 1. The collision-free sub-slice was derived deterministically from the frozen slice artifacts (fixtures/probes/selector-state/census.json zero_match_selectors, slice.json): the same schema and stored map, selector rows = the 127 zero-match selectors, every other object empty, every table empty.
2. The check arm ran on the fixture: exit 0 with zero findings — the shared path, granularity lint included, stays silent on the collision-free state.
